description: Hand your computer to the person for a step only a human can do: signing in (password, SSO, passkey), a CAPTCHA or bot check, a code sent to another device, or a site that blocks automation. Never try to bypass, solve or work around such a step. Call this instead, then end your turn with one short line. The chat shows the person an Open computer button; while they have control your screen actions are refused, and when they finish they message you to continue from where you stopped.
name: request_handback

reason.description: One short sentence naming the step, shown to the person, e.g. 'Sign in to Example to continue'.
